A 23 YEAR OLD BUILT A LUXURY ARCHITECTURE WEBSITE USING ONLY CLAUDE

> no design agency
> no expensive templates
> no WebGL

just Claude and a few smart techniques

Here is the stack:

-> CSS object-fit: cover = immersive architecture photography with zero awkward cropping

-> Vanilla Tilt.js = smooth 3D parallax effects without heavy libraries

-> Two warm colors = luxury design without visual overload

-> CSS scroll-snap = every gallery room snaps fullscreen effortlessly

-> SVG path animation = floor plan outlines draw themselves on scroll

-> IntersectionObserver = high-resolution photos load only when needed

the result?

A website that feels like a premium architecture magazine while remaining fast lightweight and responsive

most websites add complexity

the best ones remove it

🏛️ built with Claude

save this 🏛️

#ThreeJS #AI #fable #claude #webgl #gamedev #glider https://t.co/ydGpaxSjpK

A $8,400/MONTH BRAND BUILT WITH CLAUDE DESIGN IS NOT A WEBSITE DEMO. IT IS A HEADCOUNT ARBITRAGE DEMO.

The video is not showing one nice landing page.

You are looking at the boring part that used to eat 3 people and 2 weeks: brand direction, visual system, landing page, app screens, deck logic, marketing assets, and enough polish to make the thing look funded before it is.

That is the part beginners miss.

They open Claude Design and start begging for pretty screens. The article says the opposite works: do the thinking first, write the brief, lock the audience, build the design system, then let the tool produce inside a box.

The $8,400/month number is the hook. The margin is in not burning 40 regenerations because you were still deciding what the product is.

No designer, no deck person, no endless Figma loop, no “we’ll clean this up later” phase that turns into a month.

The website gets the screenshot. The system gets the business live cheap enough to test.

The "sloppy" design from Claude? My take : it's brilliant. It makes just-in-time software usable by default, gives it a shared design system, and instantly tells you: This was built with Claude. Genius.
